lines: No airt un-tenanted by thee — all hours thy tissue,
gotten already, yet when got, Lord? Utter.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yā yā dik tatra na kvāsi sarvaḥ kālo bhavanmayaḥ iti labdho 'pi karhi tvaṃ lapsyase nātha kathyatām
